title: French Terrine with Peanut Crunch
description: A classic French terrine with a satisfying crunch of peanuts. Perfect as an appetizer or light meal.

ingredients.name: Ground pork
ingredients.notes: Lean ground pork for a healthier terrine

ingredients.name: Onions
ingredients.notes: Chopped onions add flavor and texture

ingredients.name: Peanuts
ingredients.notes: Chopped peanuts for a crunchy topping

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.notes: Whole eggs for richness and binding

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.notes: Unsalted butter for flavor and richness

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Season with salt to enhance flavors

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Freshly ground black pepper for added depth

instructions: In a large pan, sauté the onions until softened.
Add the ground pork and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
In a separate bowl, mix the eggs, milk, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the egg mixture to the pork mixture and stir to combine.
Stir in the breadcrumbs and chopped peanuts.
Transfer the mixture to a terrine dish and dot with butter.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the terrine is set and golden brown.
Allow to cool before slicing and serving.
